lines.en: My breathing under the mask stays even
I pace the arena one step at a time
Heel first, then the ball of my foot
This leather armor has worn shiny

lines.zh: 影子贴在石墙上一路滑
lines.en: My shadow slides along the stone wall
I do not walk fast, but I never lose form

lines.zh: 每一步都落在同一条线上
lines.en: Each step lands on the same line
Under the mask, my ki gives nothing away.
My fists are loose, ready to close
Circling you means I am hunting a gap
I reset my breath and take another step

lines.zh: 一百八十度转身，脚步没乱
lines.en: I turn on the spot without breaking step

lines.zh: 我站着，像根插进土里的桩
lines.en: I stand like a post driven into the ground

lines.zh: 蒙面布后面的眼睛没眨
lines.en: The eyes behind my mask have not blinked

lines.zh: 我数着训练场上的节拍。
lines.en: I count the rhythm of the training yard.
Shoulders down, and the breath flows
This body can take three hundred blows
I stay still because I am saving strength
The dust in the yard has not settled yet
I crack my knuckles once
The stone under my feet is hot

lines.zh: 等一个破绽，比出手更难
lines.en: Waiting for a flaw is harder than striking

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上也不动
lines.en: Even my shadow stops moving
I am memorizing where you stand
I hold this breath deep in my chest

lines.zh: 面罩下没有人看得见我笑
lines.en: No one sees me smile under the mask

lines.zh: 你站姿松了，我看得出来
lines.en: Your stance is loose, I can tell

lines.zh: 蒙面之下我也能看清你
lines.en: Even masked, I can see you clearly
Your shoulders are leaning forward

lines.zh: 别只看我的手，看我的脚
lines.en: Do not watch my hands, watch my feet
Your center of gravity sits too high
Beneath the mask, I watch your feet.
This look is me taking your measure

lines.zh: 你眼睛往哪看，我就往哪走
lines.en: Where your eyes go, I go

lines.zh: 我的面上没有表情给你读
lines.en: My covered face gives you nothing to read
My kicks come one after another.
I know that stance, you have trained
You watch me, and I watch you
I have measured the distance between us
Do not try to get behind me

lines.zh: 你抬手之前，我已经准备
lines.en: I am ready before you raise a hand

lines.zh: 这一场，从对视就开始了
lines.en: This match began with the eye contact

lines.zh: 你的影子朝左，你习惯左转
lines.en: Your shadow leans left, you favor turning left
I dipped my head, and that was a greeting
I step back without a sound
A graze, nothing worth tending
I shift into a new stance
That hit harder than I expected
Teeth clenched, I hold my ground
Blood seeps past the edge of my mask
My guard held, I can still fight
I weigh how much that blow carried
Pain is good, it means I am alive
When I raise my head again, I am steadier
I do not eat this, but I will take it

lines.zh: 先把东西放下，再谈别的
lines.en: Set it down first, then we talk
You are trying to win me over
I take the gift, the terms are separate

lines.zh: 战场上的礼数，我不拒绝
lines.en: I do not refuse courtesy on the field
What will you trade for one technique
I have noted the gesture
I lack no food, I lack rivals
Once I take it, will you still come
Train three years first, then bring me gifts
Shoulder to shoulder, neither gave ground
Your foot slipped as you charged

lines.zh: 我侧身，你的力道就空了
lines.en: I turned, and your force found nothing

lines.zh: 碰一下就知道你的力量
lines.en: One contact tells me your strength
Do not shove, brute force will not beat me
We both stepped back at once

lines.zh: 护甲碰到护甲，声音很闷
lines.en: Armor on armor makes a dull sound
This close, it is more dangerous for you

lines.zh: 我的肘离你的肋只有一寸
lines.en: My elbow is an inch from your ribs
Stand firm, a stagger costs you
Only one who can stand beside me is worth partnering

lines.zh: 我找的是同行的拳，不是花言
lines.en: I look for a traveling fist, not sweet words

lines.zh: 同行的人要跟得上我的步子
lines.en: A partner must keep my pace
We spar first, then decide

lines.zh: 能一起熬过苦练的很少
lines.en: Few can endure the training with me

lines.zh: 这一路太远，得有个同伴
lines.en: The road is long, so I need a comrade

lines.zh: 两人一起走，路上少些冷
lines.en: Two walking together makes the road less cold

lines.zh: 我不需要追随者，需要对手
lines.en: I need no follower, I need an equal

lines.zh: 同行就得受得住我的沉默
lines.en: A comrade must bear my silence

lines.zh: 搭档之间，从来不用多说
lines.en: Partners never need many words
I bend and pick it up without breaking rhythm
This dropped at a bad moment
I flick it up with the top of my foot
Picking things up leaves me open
I tuck it into my belt
One hand picks, the other guards
No use to me, but no harm carrying it
Whoever dropped this will come back
I squeeze it to judge the weight
I keep it, and we split it later
I have found your opening

lines.zh: 场上只剩你我，那就开始
lines.en: Only you and I are left, so it begins

lines.zh: 我脚下一转，人已对准你
lines.en: One pivot and I am squared to you
This fight cannot be avoided

lines.zh: 我压住呼吸，锁定你的中线
lines.en: I hold my breath and lock onto your centerline

lines.zh: 起手之前，先看清你的脚
lines.en: Before the first strike, I read your feet
You have been counted into this fight
My guard is already set
I do not shout, shouting is wasted
Remember which way my mask faces

lines.zh: 这一眼就是开战的信号
lines.en: This look is the signal to begin
Either leave the field or take it

lines.zh: 从你抬手那刻，就算数了
lines.en: The moment you raised your hand, it counted
I press in toward you
There is only one target

lines.zh: 我不需要怒气，只需要准
lines.en: I need no anger, only precision
Every step you retreat, I advance
My kicks can chain three in a row

lines.zh: 别只顾着防你的上半身
lines.en: Do not guard only your upper body
Your left hand is late
I have slipped to your flank
Your steps are starting to drag
I left a false opening on purpose

lines.zh: 这一场要打到一个人倒下
lines.en: This ends when one of us goes down
I am setting the rhythm of the exchange
Your armor will not save your joints
I am herding you toward the corner
I count every step you trade
Your strikes are too straight, easy to read

lines.zh: 我的汗从面罩边滴下来
lines.en: Sweat drips from the edge of my mask
I have not let this breath go
Half a step closer and I kick
I can last longer than you

lines.zh: 你的肩往下沉，露出空当。
lines.en: Your shoulder drops and opens a gap.
A straight kick lands on your chest
Mid-punch I turn it into an elbow

lines.zh: 连踢三下，最后一下最沉
lines.en: Three kicks, the last is heaviest
My knee splits your guard

lines.zh: 你的手臂被我拨到一旁
lines.en: I sweep your arm out of the way

lines.zh: 这一脚扫的是你的脚踝
lines.en: This kick takes your ankle
I spin into a back kick
A palm strike sends you back

lines.zh: 我不打空，每一下都算过
lines.en: I never swing blind, every blow is planned
My fist slides off your armor
You blocked high, so you are open low
That one was three hundred drills
My fist will hurt, and I do not care
I withdraw my hand and reset my stance
A roundhouse kick drives into your ribs.
Again, and my hand comes up faster
A figure has appeared on the field

lines.zh: 任务把我从擂台边拉来。
lines.en: A mission drags me in from the arena's edge.

lines.zh: 蒙面之下，没人知道我的名字
lines.en: Under this mask, no one knows my name

lines.zh: 不是自然生的，是有人叫我来
lines.en: I was not born here, someone called me

lines.zh: 我落地时几乎没有声音
lines.en: I land with almost no sound

lines.zh: 这一场，从被召唤那刻起
lines.en: This match began the moment I was summoned

lines.zh: 我捏了捏拳，确认了身体
lines.en: I flex my fists to confirm this body
Three hundred points of endurance run in my blood
Dust spreads from my feet

lines.zh: 没有任务，我不会自己来
lines.en: Without a task, I would not come

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看这片战场
lines.en: I look up and scan this battlefield
The light behind my mask is cold
I straighten slowly and wait for you to speak
The field is clear, so I begin
I leave no loot, only memory
This is not chance, it is arrangement
I test the ground beneath me
One command, and here I stand

lines.zh: 火烧到皮甲，我拍了两下
lines.en: Fire catches my leather and I slap it out
I take the landing through my legs

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我扯紧了面罩
lines.en: Water rushes in and I tighten my mask

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得倒退数步
lines.en: The blast drives me back several steps
A ranged shot pins my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力压得我膝盖一沉
lines.en: That power drives my knees down
Fighting hungry makes the fists slow

lines.zh: 雷过身时我整个人都麻了
lines.en: Lightning leaves my whole body numb

lines.zh: 脚下没地，拳头也没了方向
lines.en: With no ground, my fists lose direction
